remarks: Oversized and updated 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom condo in fabulous hi rise bldg in the heart of downtown!  Gourmet eat in kitchen with high end cabinetry, stone countertops, stainless chef's appliances- stove, dishwasher, microwave, breakfast bar that opens into sunfilled living area w/ sliders to expansive balcony with fabulous city views! Gleaming hardwood floors throughout, large master bedroom suite w/ ample closet and private, full modern bathroom, generous sized second bedroom w/ additional full bathroom, large closets, air conditioning, gated reserved covered parking space, pet ok, walk to train, shops, nightlife, minutes to highways and beaches!
